page.overview:
Who is Golden-Winged Great Peng?

The is one of the three demons that dwelled in Lion Camel Cave on Lion Camel Ridge. By technicality, he is considered the uncle of the Tathagata Buddha.

The Golden-Winged Great Peng has a leviathan head, leopard eyes with starlike pupils, golden wings, and sharp claws.

When the universe was still forming, a phoenix's egg was inspirited by the creative aura and hatched the Golden-Winged Great Peng and the giant peacock Mahamayuri. Due to Mahamayuri swallowing the Tathagata Buddha when he was young, he is considered the Buddha's spiritual uncle.

The Golden-Winged Great Peng dwelled on Lion Camel Cave along with two other demons. When Sun Wukong invaded their lair in disguise, the Great Peng spotted him when his features momentarily returned to normal and had him trapped in his Yin-Yang Two-Energies Vase, but he soon escaped.
